unverified: No controlled counterfactual exists: the repository cannot rerun the pre-adoption regime under the new selector, so the selector's marginal causal contribution is not isolated.

The pre-adoption research-selection sample is effectively n=1 (only 37260572520 is a clearly opportunistic research-cell selection); earlier activations were infrastructure/roadmap work, so the 'before' condition is thin.

The improvement coincides with concurrent infrastructure maturation (toolkit built 2026-10-02..10-04; bash execution available from 37263008074), so part of the observed information-flow gain may be attributable to tooling maturity rather than the selector alone.

The 'no equivalent re-tests' property is realized through the frontier artifact the selector selects from; the selector and the frontier table are coupled, so their individual contributions are not separable from durable evidence alone.
git history could not be inspected (bash is project-denied at this layer); the audit relies on durable file contents, not commit timestamps.
observed_effect: Concrete selector advantage demonstrated at the level of information flow: after frontier-first adoption, six consecutive activations each selected a distinct highest-value unresolved frontier cell and closed it exactly once with a decisive verdict (5 FALSIFIED, 1 SUPPORTED) plus independent-verification MATCH and determinism, with zero equivalent re-tests and zero duplicated frontier cells. The documented pre-adoption condition shows the opposite pattern: opportunistic selection (37260572520) produced an UNVERIFIED process delta and the frontier was not operative. The advantage is real but bounded: it is confounded by concurrent toolkit maturation and the absence of a controlled counterfactual, and it is delivered through the frontier artifact rather than the selector in isolation.

Not eliminated: the selector's isolated causal share remains unresolved because infrastructure maturation coincided with adoption and no counterfactual is available; this residual is recorded rather than hidden.

It demonstrates a concrete information-flow advantage over the prior opportunistic task choice (distinct, decisively-closed, independently-verified frontier cells with no equivalent re-tests), qualified by documented confounds (concurrent infrastructure maturation; n=1 opportunistic baseline; no controlled counterfactual; advantage realized via the frontier artifact). This is a process judgment from durable evidence, not from agent confidence or execution success.
